summary:
The three fixes in /home/user/ppolppol-fix-honest (base 6d03faf, uncommitted) hold, and I would ship them. I found nothing at "must" level.

I reproduced all three lines on an untouched copy of 6d03faf by playing at 360x740 with touch:
- A real long-press on the octopus, in both 3D and 2D, showed the bubble '…좋아' and wrote a log row '혼잣말 …좋아'.
- Ten nap-timer steps under a fake clock gave labels that alternate between '꿈꾸는 중' and '자는 중', in both 3D and 2D.
- A model replay ending with the reaction 폴짝 set #scene-desc to '…포스터 판 앞에서 신나 있어.'

On the fixed tree, the same probes give:
- The pet bubble is only '…', in 3D and 2D, in the pixel and system fonts, at 360x740 and 320x568. The log row is now '혼잣말 …'.
- The nap label reads '자는 중' on all 10 timer steps, in 3D and 2D, at both sizes.
- The real replay path gives '…포스터 판 앞에서 통통 뛰고 있어.'

With reduced motion, the happy state lasts 7 ms before the walk or sleep takes over, so the "bouncing" wording never describes a still octopus.

Other checks:
- The bubble sits inside the scene at 320 px.
- npm test passes (exit 0) and the font check says 'stale: none'.
- The new A-2 checks passed 5 runs out of 5 in a row on this loaded machine (load 6.8 to 9.1).
- Reverting each fix alone fails exactly its own A-2 check. Three of my own four mutants also fail.
- The edits to Y block 12 keep it as strict as before.
- SMOKE_ONLY=A passed 80/0.

Smoke Y crashed on a 5 s wait in the sheet-close block (smoke.js:2644) before it reached the petting checks. An untouched 6d03faf copy crashed the same way at the same block (base line 2591) under the same load, so I give no verdict on Y. Its E2 petting checks did not run in my session.

Where I disagree with the fix agent's report is its list of other lines that state the octopus's feelings. It is incomplete:
- **The far-sea door dialog (index.html:231)** says the octopus wants something: '문어가 먼 바다 문 너머까지 가 보고 싶대.' A player sees it whenever a connected model proposes opening the door.
- **Some demo-brain lines were missed.** These claim curiosity or being drawn somewhere: '…궁금했어', '…끌렸어' and '이만하면 됐다 싶었어'.
- **The repo's own skill file** (.claude/skills/cozy-web-game/references/octopus-lore.md) still tells future work, as a 'must', to use a '꿈꾸는 중?' sleep label.

There are also an owner question about the heart particle and blush that remain after petting, a test gap (a feeling word on the 30 % walk branch after petting would not be caught), and two nits.

problems.title: The far-sea door dialog says the octopus wants to go; the fix agent's list missed it
problems.where: index.html:231 (#far-dialog .name-lead); shown by js/app.js farAsk() near 3236 when /api/walks returns far.state 'proposed'
problems.what: Code-written text tells the player '문어가 먼 바다 문 너머까지 가 보고 싶대.' ('the octopus says it wants to go beyond the far-sea door'). The model only took the action 'propose' (mcp/core.js:738), with an optional line of its own that is shown separately as '· 문어가 쓴 말'. Paraphrasing that action as a want goes against the wording of hard line 1 ('nothing may say or imply what the octopus … wants'). The item-5 sweep in the report says no other code line outside the demo data was found, which is not true. The brief's word list had no 싶 or 궁금, but the brief said 'words like'.
problems.evidence: grep -n '보고 싶대' index.html → line 231. The text is in a static dialog that any connected player sees after a proposal. No doc mentions this wording (grep in docs/, mcp/, api/ found nothing). I confirmed it twice by grep; I did not open the dialog in a browser, because it needs a live /api/far room.
problems.suggested_fix: State the action instead: '문어가 먼 바다 문 너머까지 가 보자고 했어.' Then add it to the A-2 FEEL_RX family, or add a static test that greps index.html and js/ for code lines containing 싶대 or 싶어.

problems.title: The repo skill still prescribes the removed '꿈꾸는 중?' label as a 'must'
problems.what: Line 156 reads '**must** 잠 상태를 … 활동 잠(색 순환, 라벨 "꿈꾸는 중?")'. Agents working on this repo load this skill. A future change that follows it would bring back the label this fix removed. The A-2 nap check would catch that, but the skill would keep pushing the wrong way. The fix agent listed this under 'left' and did not change it.
problems.evidence: grep -rn '꿈꾸는 중' over the repo (excluding wip/ and node_modules) → octopus-lore.md:59 and :156 are the only places outside history docs and comments that still recommend it.
problems.suggested_fix: Change both lines to '자는 중' with a dated 11-13 note (hard line 1: no claimed inner experience). The colour cycle stays shown by colour only.

problems.title: More demo-brain lines claim feelings, beyond the ones the agent listed
problems.where: js/brain.js:40 (IGNORED_NOTE '오늘은 그쪽 말고 다른 데가 궁금했어'), js/brain.js:47 ('…쪽이 궁금했어', '{hint} 말고 {mem} 쪽이 끌렸어'), js/brain.js:841 ('…이만하면 됐다 싶었어'), and the same lines in js/world.js:1340, 1370, 1488
problems.what: The agent's list of world.js demo lines (109, 985, 1141, 1251, 1255, 1290, 1494, 1514, plus app.js:2910) misses these. They claim curiosity ('was curious'), attraction ('was drawn to') and contentment ('felt it was enough'). Like the agent's list, they appear only under the '데모' tag, and the model voice skips them (brain.js:1101).
problems.suggested_fix: The owner decides whether hard line 1 covers rule-written demo lines. Options: (a) keep them, since the '데모' tag says the code wrote them (cost: the demo still voices feelings in the octopus's first person); (b) rewrite them as plain facts ('오늘은 {mem} 쪽으로 갔어'), which costs some charm in the demo.

problems.title: After petting, the octopus still shows liking without words: heart particle, blush and smiling face
problems.where: js/app.js:1613 UIART.fx('heart'); js/scene3d.js:1914 and 2986 (pet blush); pet portrait with closed smiling eyes (screenshot fix-360x740-2d-pet.png, log row '혼잣말 …')
problems.what: The brief kept the heart on purpose. Still, the heart, blush and smiling eyes together still imply 'it likes being petted', which is what hard line 1 asks not to imply. Removing the words fixed the line that said it, not the picture that shows it.
problems.evidence: In the 2D screenshot, the log box after petting shows a blushing face with closed smiling eyes beside '…'. The heart particle fires on every pet (app.js:1613).
problems.suggested_fix: For the owner. (a) Keep it: petting is the player's own act, the heart can be read as the player's affection, and the cost is a soft implication. (b) Swap the heart for a neutral particle, such as dust or a ripple, and drop the blush; this costs some warmth. (c) Keep the heart but keep the octopus's face idle while being petted.

problems.title: The pet check sees only the first bubble, so a feeling word on the 30 % branch goes uncaught
problems.what: The check stops at the first long-press that shows a bubble, which in practice is the 70 % '…' branch. My mutant M7 adds say('…좋아') to the other branch, where the octopus walks away (app.js:1621). It passed 6/0.
problems.suggested_fix: Keep pressing after the first bubble until both branches have been seen at least once (for example, up to 15 presses), and require every bubble ever shown to be exactly '…'. Or stub uiRng to force each branch once.

problems.title: A stale comment still names the pet bubble as '♡'
problems.what: The comment on expressions still says the pet bubble is '♡'. The pet bubble is now '…'.
